# requires: wire
#
# The multipart body again, this time under a top-level Content-Range naming
# exactly the span that was asked for. Every offset check passes and the bytes
# are still MIME, so the only thing left standing is the media type: a
# multipart/byteranges body answers a request we never send, whatever its
# headers agree about.
#
# Without that rule the boundary line goes into the artifact and the digest
# catches it — one language at a time, and identically in all three, which is
# the shape of defect no cross-implementation diff can see.
submit A size=64 digest=good src=http:markedmultipart
claim A alpha 5000
stage A 40
progress A alpha 40 {"verified_prefix":40}
release A alpha
run A beta
orphans
state A

# expect 6: ok state=transferred [DL-R8]
# expect 6: done=64 err=none
# expect 7: ok -
